lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a staggered grid-like formation posterior to the gill region, forming approximately five identifiable horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid of anchor nodes most prominent in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is present on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and lower-intensity shadow values on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller, less-defined high-luminance clusters that appear more tightly packed and irregularly distributed compared to the primary lateral flank patterning.
